title: Crash: Trying to unreference a SafeRefCount which is already zero
body:
### Tested versions

Custom build, with some changes after 4.7 dev4 e9eecc411f2b6cddb0f1001db1da3ed73b68c307:


### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable (14d1969) - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Mon, 09 Feb 2026 17:16:33 +0000 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Single-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon 780M Graphics (radeonsi, phoenix, LLVM 21.1.6, DRM 3.64, 6.18.9-arch1-2) - AMD Ryzen 7 8745HS w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (16 threads) - 28.18 GiB memory

### Issue description

Might be related to 
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/118612
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/118615


I got this stack trace, with some of the messages before it:

### Steps to reproduce

I know this isn't much to go on, but:

The game was running from the Godot Editor, I was editing `Globals.gd` in VSCode. , and editing but when viewing the stack trace in my debugger (this was a dev build), the parsed file during the crash was `main_code_edit.gd` (the function being editing in Globals.gd was called in main_code_edit.gd, but the erroring line that was being parsed was much before the globals function was called).

I think this might be race condition related, for reference the Globals.gd file is 1200 lines, and main_code_edit.gd is 4200 lines. I have auto-save enabled in VSCode as well. Is it possible all the "threads" that are attempting to parse aren't discarded once a new one has started (i.e. no point in parsing when you are parsing out dated info)?
